title: Kingdom Event
note: Rolled in the Event Phase of a Kingdom Turn (reference/kingdom-turn.md) when the event check hits. Resolve as a kingdom-skill challenge vs Control DC; many events seed a Thread, a Character, or an Adventure Feature. [d] dangerous, [n] neutral, [+] beneficial.

entries.value: [d] Bandit Activity — raiders strike a hex/worksite; Warfare/Defense or lose RP & gain Unrest
[d] Monster Activity — a creature menaces a settlement (often an un-cleared hex's denizen); Warfare or Wilderness
[d] Crop Failure / Blight — Agriculture; shortfall raises Consumption and Unrest
[d] Plague / Epidemic — Defense/Folklore; spreads and drains a settlement if unchecked
[d] Public Scandal — a leader is disgraced; Politics/Statecraft or +Unrest, role penalty
[d] Sensational Crime — Intrigue/Defense; failure feeds Crime Ruin
[d] Local / Natural Disaster — fire, flood, storm; Engineering/Wilderness or Decay Ruin
[d] Cult Activity — the Bloom or a dark faith takes root; Folklore/Magic; ties to the hidden curse
[d] Feud / Squabble — factions clash; Politics or +Unrest/Strife
[d] Unrest Stirring / Inquisition — agitators (e.g. a Pitax envoy); Intrigue/Statecraft
[n] Demand for Expansion — subjects want new land claimed; Exploration; reward or grumbling
[n] Land Rush / Pilgrimage — newcomers flock in; Trade/Folklore; growth with growing pains
[+] Diplomatic Overture — a faction offers terms; Statecraft → alliance, trade, or aid
[+] Visiting Celebrity — a noble/bard/hero arrives; Arts/Politics → boons and renown
[n] Festival / Festive Invitation — a celebration (or a rival's, e.g. Rushlight); Arts; morale & risk
[+] Economic Surge / Boomtown — Trade/Industry → RP and a thriving settlement
[+] Food Surplus — Agriculture → stored Food, lowered Consumption pressure
[+] Justice Prevails — Defense/Intrigue → reduce a Ruin, lower Unrest
[+] Remarkable Discovery / Treasure — Exploration/Scholarship → a resource, relic, or lore lead
[+] Outstanding Success — a leader's brilliance; +kingdom ability boost or a free activity
